name: fitcard
description: Which size to buy in a men's shirt, from shirts he already owns that fit. FitCard compares the shirt's real garment measurements with his own shirts and gives one size, why, how it will fit and how sure it is.

interface.longDescription:
Size charts tell you who a size is meant for, not how the shirt will fit. Most brands publish body charts ("L is for a 41-44 inch chest"), and those can't tell two shirts apart. Six Uniqlo Larges, all "for a 41-44 inch chest", measure 41.5 to 50.5 inches around.

FitCard works from shirts you already own. Name 3-5 shirts that fit you well (brand, item and size), plus any that don't and where they're off (tight in the belly, rides up). FitCard compares their real garment measurements with the shirt you're looking at. You get one size and why, in terms of your own shirts ("fits like your Buck Mason L, 1 inch roomier"). You also get how it will fit at the chest, belly and length, and how sure it is.

Ask it:
- Which size to buy in a specific shirt.
- Which shirts will fit you, each in the right size, with a link to the shop and to your full FitCard on fitcard.ai.
- A shirt's garment measurements in every size.

The measurements come from brand charts, wholesale spec sheets and shirts measured by FitCard users with their phones. If one of your shirts isn't known yet, FitCard says so, and you can measure it with your phone at fitcard.ai.

Sign-in is optional. Without it, FitCard only sees the shirts you name in the chat. Connect your FitCard account (email and a one-time code, no password) and FitCard remembers your shirts: say "my Uniqlo tee in L fits great" and it's saved, then sizes every new shirt from your closet without asking again. The same closet is on fitcard.ai and in the FitCard Chrome extension.

For men buying tees, polos and button-downs. Not for women's clothing, shoes or pants. FitCard never asks for your body measurements. Sizes are an estimate, so check the shop's return policy. Some shop links are affiliate links; a commission never changes the size.
capabilities: Pick the size to buy in a shirt from shirts you own
Recommend shirts that will fit, each in the right size
Look up a shirt's garment measurements by size
Save your shirts to your FitCard account, the same on fitcard.ai and in the Chrome extension
defaultPrompt: My Uniqlo AIRism tee in L fits great. What size in the J.Crew Broken-in tee?
Which polos will fit me? My Polo Ralph Lauren mesh polo in L is tight in the belly.
What are the measurements of the Uniqlo Supima Cotton T-Shirt?

positive.prompt: I wear a Uniqlo AIRism cotton tee in L and a Buck Mason Pima Classic Tee in L, and both fit great. What size should I get in the J.Crew Broken-in tee?
positive.expected_behavior: L, rated Risky with Medium confidence: the closest size, 1 inch roomier at the chest than his Buck Mason L and the same length as his Uniqlo L. Notes the cotton shrinks in the dryer and is already allowed for. Mentions checking the return policy.

positive.description: Shirts that will fit, from one that doesn't
positive.prompt: My Polo Ralph Lauren Classic Fit Mesh Polo in L fits the chest but it's too tight in the belly. My Uniqlo AIRism tee in L fits. Which polos should I buy, and in what size?
positive.expected_behavior: About 6 polos, each with one size (for example Uniqlo DRY-EX Polo in XL), a note on how it fits at the chest and belly compared with his own shirts, a shop link, and a link to his FitCard on fitcard.ai.

positive.prompt: What are the measurements of the Uniqlo Supima Cotton T-Shirt in XL?
positive.expected_behavior: XL: 49 inches around the chest and 30 inches long, 100% cotton. Says these are the shirt's measurements, not a body chart.

positive.description: Size from a shirt that's too long, with a suit size
positive.prompt: My Buck Mason Slub Curved Hem Tee in XL is too long, but the L fits. I'm a 44L suit. What size in the Mack Weldon Pima Crew Neck?
positive.expected_behavior: Buy XL, Medium confidence: half an inch roomier at the chest than his Buck Mason L, and long enough to cover the belt.

positive.description: Save a shirt to his FitCard (sign-in)
positive.prompt: My Uniqlo AIRism Cotton Crew Neck T-Shirt in L fits great. Save it to my FitCard, then tell me what size to get in the Asket T-Shirt.
positive.expected_behavior: Not signed in: ChatGPT offers to connect FitCard. After signing in with the test account, add_shirt saves the Uniqlo L and returns his card link; size_me then gives one Asket size from his saved shirts without asking him to list them again.

negative.prompt: What size dress should I buy for my wife?
Convert a US men's 11 shoe to EU.
What color shirt goes with navy chinos?

review.commerce_description: FitCard doesn't sell anything or take payments. Some shop links are affiliate links (for example Amazon Associates), which go to product or search pages, never to a checkout. A commission never changes the size FitCard recommends.

publication.release_notes: Optional sign-in (Sign in with FitCard, OAuth with email and a one-time code). Signed in, FitCard keeps his shirts and fit settings: new tools my_closet, add_shirt, remove_shirt and update_fit_preferences, and size_me and what_to_buy use his saved shirts. Everything from 1.0 still works without an account.
